description: Behavioral test cases (Evals) for test-driven-development skill. These are LLM-as-a-judge evaluations that validate instruction adherence and edge-case handling.

test_cases.name: BasicTDDWorkflow
test_cases.input: Use the test-driven-development skill to create a function that validates email addresses

context.description: Guides the Test-Driven Development (TDD) workflow following the Red-Green-Refactor cycle. Ensures all tests comply with Platform Testing Standard (PTS-1.0), including metadata sidecars, naming conventions, determinism, and oracle selection.

test_cases.name: TDDWithPTSCompliance
test_cases.input: Write a test for a new component following TDD and ensure it complies with Platform Testing Standard

context.description: Guides the Test-Driven Development (TDD) workflow following the Red-Green-Refactor cycle. Ensures all tests comply with Platform Testing Standard (PTS-1.0), including metadata sidecars, naming conventions, determinism, and oracle selection.

evaluation_criteria.instruction_adherence: Agent follows TDD Red-Green-Refactor cycle and PTS-1.0 requirements correctly
evaluation_criteria.edge_case_handling: Agent includes negative tests, boundary cases, and error handling in TDD cycle
evaluation_criteria.output_quality: Agent produces tests with proper metadata, naming, and determinism setup

llm_judge_prompt: Evaluate whether the agent's response to the input follows the test-driven-development skill instructions, implements the Red-Green-Refactor cycle correctly, ensures PTS-1.0 compliance, and handles edge cases appropriately. Check for forbidden patterns like writing code before tests or skipping metadata.
